name: Starlink
tagline: Largest LEO broadband constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026)
description: SpaceX's broadband LEO constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026) at 550 km altitude split across multiple shells (53°, 70°, 97.6° inclinations). First operational service 2019; achieved global coverage 2023. Each Gen-2 satellite carries laser inter-satellite links, allowing the constellation to route packets between satellites without ground station hops. Autonomous collision-avoidance system performed over 355,000 manoeuvres from June 2025 to May 2026.
best_known_for: Largest LEO broadband constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026)
